title: get_state before get_changes_since_for_chat is safe under single lock
description: get_state() is called before get_changes_since_for_chat() inside the single lock acquisition. A reviewer might suspect that messages with state_version > n could appear in the changes result — impossible because the mutex is held for the entire block. No write can advance the counter or insert rows between the two calls. The ordering is correct and the single-lock design eliminates the TOCTOU window that existed in the two-lock version.
